issues.t: Rattle or knock at cold start
issues.sym: A chattering, rattling or knocking noise from the engine for a few seconds after starting, mostly after the car has sat overnight.
issues.why: The timing chain tensioner may not hold oil pressure while the engine sits, so the chain slaps until pressure builds. Kia issued a bulletin to replace the tensioner for this noise.
issues.next: Note when the noise happens and how long it lasts, then have a Kia dealer check it against the timing chain tensioner bulletin (ENG148). A noise that gets louder or stays after warm-up needs prompt attention.

issues.t: Rough idle right after a cold start
issues.sym: The engine shakes or idles roughly for the first 30 to 45 seconds after a cold start, then smooths out.
issues.why: Kia described this on the 3.3L direct-injection V6 in a service bulletin (PS320); it is tied to how the engine runs while warming up rather than a failed part.
issues.next: If it clears up within a minute and there is no check engine light, it is usually considered normal. If it lasts longer or a light comes on, have it checked.

issues.t: Misfire and rough running from injector deposits
issues.sym: Rough running, hesitation, poor fuel economy or a flashing check engine light with misfire codes, often at higher mileage.
issues.why: Direct-injection engines spray fuel straight into the cylinders, and deposits can build up on the injector tips and change the spray. Kia issued a bulletin on GDI injector tip deposits.
issues.next: Use quality fuel and keep up with oil changes. If misfires show up, a shop can test the injectors and clean or replace them.

issues.t: Check engine light with code P0315
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on, sometimes with a misfire code, and code P0315 is stored.
issues.why: The engine computer has not learned the small variations in the crankshaft position signal, which it uses to detect misfires. Kia covered this in a bulletin (PS417).
issues.next: Have the codes read. A dealer can run the crankshaft position relearn procedure, which usually clears it without parts.

issues.t: Oil leak from the oil pressure switch
issues.sym: Oil drips under the front of the car, oil residue on the engine, or a burning oil smell.
issues.why: The oil pressure switch can leak oil. Kia offered a warranty extension (WTY026) to replace it on affected engines.
issues.next: Check your oil level. Ask a Kia dealer if the oil pressure switch warranty extension covers your VIN before paying for the repair.

issues.t: Harsh or erratic shifting
issues.sym: Rough, delayed or jerky shifts, flaring between gears, or a check engine light with transmission codes.
issues.why: Kia released a transmission computer software update to improve shift logic, and a bulletin to replace solenoids when certain transmission codes are stored.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask a Kia dealer about the transmission software update (TRA056) and solenoid bulletin (TRA051) for your VIN.

issues.t: Shift quality complaints on the 8-speed
issues.sym: Hesitation, clunky or busy shifting at low speed.
issues.why: Kia issued a service action (SA337) with a transmission software update to improve shift logic on these years.
issues.next: Ask a Kia dealer to check your VIN for service action SA337 and the latest transmission software.

issues.t: Clunk or knock in the steering column
issues.sym: A clicking, clunking or knocking felt in the steering wheel, especially when turning slowly or parking, and sometimes extra play in the wheel.
issues.why: The electric power steering has a rubber flexible coupling between the motor and steering shaft that wears out. Kia issued several bulletins and a warranty extension (WTY013) for the coupling.
issues.next: Have a Kia dealer inspect the steering coupling and check whether the warranty extension applies. The coupling itself is an inexpensive part.

issues.t: Ticking from the steering gear when turning
issues.sym: A ticking or tapping noise from the front when turning the wheel.
issues.why: Kia issued a bulletin (CHA091) for a steering gear yoke plug adjustment or replacement to stop this noise.
issues.next: Have a dealer check the steering gear for the yoke plug fix.

issues.t: Windshield may detach (recall)
issues.sym: There may be no warning. Loose or shifted windshield trim, wind noise or water leaks around the glass could be signs.
issues.why: Some windshields were not bonded properly at the factory, so the glass could come loose. Kia recalled all 2014-2016 Cadenzas (22V158).
issues.next: Contact a Kia dealer with your VIN. They inspect the glass and remove and reinstall the windshield if needed, free of charge.

issues.t: 19-inch wheel may crack (recall)
issues.sym: A sudden loss of tire pressure or a vibration after hitting a pothole.
issues.why: Some non-chrome 19-inch alloy wheels on cars built February to August 2013 could fracture after a hard impact. Kia recalled them (14V289).
issues.next: Check whether your car has the 19-inch non-chrome wheels and give your VIN to a Kia dealer. The wheels are replaced free.

issues.t: Engine compartment fire from ABS module (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell or smoke from under the hood, an ABS light, or a fire, even while parked.
issues.why: The ABS hydraulic control unit can short internally. Kia recalled the Cadenza under campaign 23V652 to add a fuse that prevents a fire.
issues.next: Park outside until the fix is done and contact a Kia dealer with your VIN for the free repair.

issues.t: ABS module short could start a fire (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell, smoke from the engine bay or an ABS warning light.
issues.why: The ABS hydraulic control unit (HECU) circuit can short and cause an engine compartment fire. Kia recalled the Cadenza (21V137); dealers replace fuses and update software on cars with an electronic parking brake.
issues.next: Park outside and away from buildings until the recall is done. Give your VIN to a Kia dealer to schedule the free repair.

issues.t: Brake vacuum hose may kink (recall)
issues.sym: The brake pedal feels hard and the car takes longer to stop.
issues.why: On a small number of 2017 Cadenzas the brake booster vacuum hose could kink, reducing power assist. Kia recalled them (17V190).
issues.next: Ask a Kia dealer to check your VIN. The hose is inspected and replaced free if needed.

issues.t: Rear windows work after ignition off (recall)
issues.sym: The rear power windows can still be moved after the car is turned off when a front door is opened.
issues.why: Driver door module software allowed the rear windows to operate when they should be disabled, which does not meet the federal safety standard meant to protect children. Kia recalled the cars (22V022).
issues.next: Have a Kia dealer update the driver door module software for free.

issues.t: A/C not blowing cold
issues.sym: The air conditioning blows warm or only slightly cool air.
issues.why: Low refrigerant from a leak or a failing compressor are typical causes. Kia also issued a bulletin on replacing the receiver/dryer after metal debris contaminates the A/C system.
issues.next: Have the A/C pressures and compressor checked rather than just adding refrigerant. If the compressor failed, the system must be flushed and the dryer replaced.

issues.t: Rattles and creaks from the sunroof
issues.sym: Rattling, squeaking or creaking noises from the roof area over bumps.
issues.why: Kia issued a bulletin (PS282) on sunroof-area noises, usually from the sunroof frame or trim.
issues.next: Have a dealer check the sunroof against the bulletin. Cleaning and lubricating the tracks can also help.

issues.t: Panoramic sunroof slow or noisy when closing
issues.sym: The panoramic sunroof closes slowly, stops partway, or makes a grinding or clicking noise.
issues.why: Kia issued a bulletin (BOD204) for this and a reset procedure for the sunroof motor.
issues.next: Try the sunroof reset procedure in the owner manual. If it still misbehaves, have a dealer check it under the bulletin.

issues.t: Electronic thermostat replaced under service action
issues.sym: A check engine light or engine temperature concern.
issues.why: Kia ran service actions (SA299 and SA346) to replace the electronically controlled thermostat on these cars.
issues.next: Ask a Kia dealer to check your VIN for open service actions SA299 or SA346 and have the thermostat replaced free if it applies.

issues.t: Evaporative leak code from fuel pump seal
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with EVAP leak codes such as P0456 or P0442. You might notice a faint fuel smell.
issues.why: The seal at the top of the fuel pump in the tank can be damaged, letting fuel vapor escape. Kia covered this in a bulletin (PS567).
issues.next: Make sure the gas cap is tight first. If the light returns, have the EVAP system smoke-tested and the fuel pump seal checked.

issues.t: Airbag warning light on
issues.sym: The airbag warning light stays on.
issues.why: Kia issued a warranty extension (WTY027) and bulletin for inspecting and replacing the airbag control unit.
issues.next: Airbags may not work while the light is on. Have the codes read and ask a Kia dealer whether the warranty extension covers your car.

issues.t: Low-beam headlight connector failure
issues.sym: One low-beam headlight flickers or goes out even with a new bulb.
issues.why: The connector for the halogen low-beam bulb can overheat and fail. Kia issued a bulletin (ELE148) to replace it.
issues.next: If a new bulb does not fix it, have the bulb connector checked and replaced.

issues.t: No sound from speakers or navigation glitches
issues.sym: The navigation/audio unit suddenly stops playing sound from all speakers, or the map shows errors.
issues.why: The head unit can fail or need a software update. Kia issued several navigation software and SD card bulletins for this car.
issues.next: Try a full power-off restart. If sound does not return, ask a dealer about software updates before replacing the head unit.

issues.t: Electric power steering column noise or fault
issues.sym: A clunk, knock or grinding felt in the steering wheel, uneven steering effort, or a power steering warning light.
issues.why: The column-mounted electric power steering (C-MDPS) can develop wear in its motor, worm gear or bearings. Kia issued a long-running bulletin (CHA084) allowing partial repair of the motor, control unit, worm gear or housing, and another (CHA111) for a small bearing.
issues.next: Have a Kia dealer inspect the steering column under these bulletins; a partial repair costs far less than replacing the whole column.

issues.t: Oil filler cap replaced under emissions campaign
issues.sym: Often no symptom. Some owners may notice an oily smell under the hood.
issues.why: Kia ran a voluntary emissions service campaign (SC169) to inspect and, if needed, replace the engine oil filler cap on these cars.
issues.next: Ask a Kia dealer to check your VIN for campaign SC169. The inspection and cap are free.
